title: Portfolio Website
description: A fast, animated personal portfolio built with Vite and React, deployed via GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages. Content is driven entirely by JSON data files so it's easy to extend without touching layout code.

title: data-annotation-qna-tool
description: A Python tool for validating the quality of image object-detection annotations (COCO-style bounding boxes). Built to simulate a real annotation-review pipeline: generate/ingest annotated data, then automatically flag common labeling errors before the dataset is used for model training.

title: Cache Controller FSM Simulator
description: This project implements a finite state machine (FSM)-based cache controller based on Patterson & Hennessy (Computer Organization and Design). The simulator models a direct-mapped cache with write-back and write-allocate policies and shows cycle-by-cycle state transitions.
